metadata.description: Community-driven achievement tracking for native static recompilations and PC ports.

footer.disclaimer: RecompAchievements tracks achievement definitions and player progress only. It does not host games, ROMs, or copyrighted assets, and is not affiliated with any game publisher, platform holder, or RetroAchievements.

home.title: Achievements for {highlight}.
home.intro: Track your progress in static recompilations and PC ports that run outside emulators. Recomp developers trigger achievements straight from native code; you collect points, chase rare unlocks, and show off your profile.
home.sampleDescription: Defeat the first boss without taking damage.

alpha.metaDescription: Sign up to test RecompAchievements before launch: earn achievements in native recomps and help shape the platform.
alpha.title: Join the Alpha
alpha.intro: Be one of the first players to earn achievements in native recomps. Alpha testers try new features before anyone else and help shape the platform.
testers: Play supported recomps with achievements switched on.
Report bugs and share what feels good or bad.
Help decide which recomps get achievements first.
alpha.store: Your email, nickname, platforms, and the recomps you play, only to run the alpha. Details are in our {privacy}.

form.consent: I agree to the {privacy} and to being contacted about the alpha.

alphaConfirm.title: Confirm Your Alpha Sign-Up
alphaConfirm.body: Press the button to confirm your email address and join the alpha.
alphaConfirm.successBody: Your email is confirmed. We’ll write to you as soon as the alpha opens.
alphaConfirm.expiredBody: Confirmation links last 7 days. Sign up again to get a new one.
alphaConfirm.invalidBody: It may be incomplete, or a newer email replaced it. Sign up again to get a new link.
alphaConfirm.unavailable: We couldn’t confirm your email right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: RecompAchievements is a community project. This notice explains what we collect when you sign up for the alpha, why, and how to remove it.

sections.title: What We Collect
sections.body: When you sign up for the alpha: your email address, nickname, the platforms you play on, the recomps you mention, the site language you used, and when you agreed to this notice and confirmed your email. We don’t store your IP address.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: Only to run the alpha: to confirm your email, invite you when the alpha opens, and organize testing. We don’t sell or share your data, and we don’t send marketing emails.

sections.title: Where It’s Kept
sections.body: In our database at our hosting provider. Confirmation emails are sent through our email delivery provider. Both act only on our instructions.

sections.title: How Long
sections.body: Unconfirmed sign-ups are deleted automatically 7 days after the link is sent. Confirmed sign-ups are kept until the alpha ends, then deleted unless you create an account.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: No tracking or advertising cookies. One functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers the language you chose.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You can ask to see, correct, or delete your data at any time by writing to {email}.
